notes: Named only in the invention title on the cover sheet; the section describes no procedure, so is_section_product is false. Translation conflict: the EN line renders 环磺酮 as "a cyclic sulfone ketone (huanhuangtong)", a literal character-by-character gloss that names no specific compound. The Chinese 环磺酮 is the standard common name for tembotrione and is followed here. The printed Int.Cl. classes C07C 315/04, C07C 317/24 and C07C 317/46 are sulfone classes, supporting the sulfone functional group.
